newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Lam Soon, unit shrs suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Lam Soon, unit shrs suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Lam Soon (Hong Kong) Ltd and its Lam Soon Food Industries Ltd unit was suspended at the companies' request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Wednesday.
Shares of food processing concern Lam Soon (Hong Kong) fell HK$0.02 to HK$1.33 on Tuesday. Lam Soon Food was unchanged at HK$0.82.
Lam Soon Food is due to release its final results due later on Wednesday.
Lam Soon (Hong Kong) and Lam Soon Food said earlier this year that they were considering proposals for a possible capital restructuring of the companies.
